label: verify-q1-data

claims.claim: Same 98 enhancers measured on 15 promoters with 3 replicates, in a public GEO file.
claims.source_says: 3 Biological replicates of cDNA samples for each library mix, 2 pDNA replicates for each library mix and 1 iPCR sequencing run per separate library.
claims.note: GEO confirms 3 cDNA replicates and the Upstream all-combinations file; the 98 x 15 panel is the agent's own subset (summary_main.json lists 98 enhancers, 15 promoters), not stated by GEO.

claims.claim: Promoter-to-promoter Spearman median 0.38, range -0.29 to 0.72, below 0.81 expected for a multiplicative model with same noise.
claims.note: Numbers match the agent's summary file after rounding; I did not re-run the script.

claims.claim: About 26% of doubly-significant orderings reverse (65,174 of 224,658 overall), versus 368 expected from noise.
claims.note: The counts and null match, but 65,174/224,658 is 29.0%; the 26% is the median per-pair fraction, so 'overall' wording is wrong.

claims.claim: Rank-one fit explains 71% of linear-scale matrix; log-scale interaction is 27% of variance and 11.9x noise.
claims.note: All three figures match the summary file; 'good approximation but not exact' is interpretation.

overall: Three of four claims reproduce from the agent's summary file; the reversal claim mislabels a 29.0% overall rate as 26% (the per-pair median), and the 98x15 panel is the agent's own subset, not a GEO statement. I did not re-run the analysis script.
